projects.title: hoverboard-firmware-hack-FOC
projects.blurb: Bare-metal STM32F103 motor FOC. The control loop runs in the ADC-DMA interrupt, the super-loop in main changes targets; every conflict candidate is interrupt ↔ main.

projects.title: STM32H743-CMake-Template
projects.blurb: FreeRTOS on a Cortex-M7: 3 tasks, 14 interrupts, a software timer and a CLI. Shown as one partition — Core, Applications, the CLI and the kernel — the way you would scan a folder of it; LVGL and the HAL stay outside.

projects.title: grblHAL ESP32
projects.blurb: grblHAL CNC controller on ESP32 (Xtensa, ESP-IDF + FreeRTOS). One application task plus interrupts installed through esp_intr_alloc / timer_isr_register / gpio_isr_register — no vector table. The ESP-IDF framework itself is outside the project root and stays out of the facts.

projects.title: Grbl_Esp32
projects.blurb: Grbl CNC controller on ESP32 through the Arduino core (C++). setup()/loop() come from the framework; seven FreeRTOS tasks, three interrupts installed with timer_isr_register and attachInterrupt. Archived upstream (succeeded by FluidNC) — shown as a fixed snapshot.
